Weekly Discovery — Saturday, October 3 2026

Home Assistant 2026.10 heads to stable release; Netatmo adds dual-protocol thermostats with Zigbee and Matter support.

Home Automation

#2 — Netatmo Upgrades Smart Heating: New Thermostatic Valves Support Zigbee and Matter — Maison et Domotique

★ Direct upgrade path for your eight Netatmo radiator valve entities currently running over HomeKit Controller; new models add Zigbee and Matter options with better local control.

Netatmo expands its ORIGINAL range with new Zigbee and Matter thermostatic radiator valves, and it now runs on Zigbee, with support for Matter. The valves and thermostats don't speak Matter themselves; they communicate with the Thermo Hub over Zigbee, and it acts as the bridge to Matter.
